newsitem.title: LEBANON: Solidere rise ahead of GDR issue.
newsitem.headline: Solidere rise ahead of GDR issue.

text.p: Solidere shares rose on higher turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange (BSE) on Monday, one day before the company is expected to make a $125 million GDR issue.
A shares were up to $115 from $114.75 on Thursday and B shares rose slightly to $117.875 from $117.625.
Turnover in Solidere shares on the BSE rose to 19,173 shares from Thursday's 15,500 shares and value was $2,217,880 from $1,796,095.625.
Market sources have said Solidere will issue on Tuesday 10 million Global Depositary Receipts (GDR) worth up to $125 million. Each GDR will be worth one tenth of the company's shares.
Also traded on the BSE were 100 shares of Ciments Libanais at $1.25, down from $1.2812 on November 15, when they were last traded.
The LISPI stock index rose 0.56 percent to 84.01 and the BLOM stock index fell 0.24 percent to 980.13.
